title: Key Resignation: Austin Corporation Court Judge
summary:
*   The city held a brief special meeting to address a single item of business.
*   Officials accepted the resignation of Ivan Williams, who served as the Judge of the Corporation Court.
*   Mr. Williams' resignation from his judicial post was effective starting February 23, 1968.
transcript:
_ CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
Special Meeting
February 05, 1968
4:35 Ρ.Μ.
Council Chamber, City Hall
The meeting was called to order with Mayor Akin presiding. Roll Call: Present: Councilmen
LaRue, Nichols, Mayor Akin
Absent: Councilmen Janes, Long
MAYOR AKIN announced this was a Special Meeting called for the purpose of accepting the
Resignation of IVAN WILLIAMS as Judge of the Corporation Court.
Mayor Akin read Mr. Williams' letter of resignation as follows: "February 5, 1968
"Mayor Akin, Mrs. Long, and Gentlemen:
"I do hereby resign as Judge of the Corporation Court of the City of Austin, a municipal
corporation, effective February 23, 1968.
"It has been my pleasure to serve in the capacity as Judge of the Corporation Court. I
shall always be grateful to each of you and to the members of the
Council who originally appointed me.
"Yours very truly,
/s Ivan R. Williams, Jr."
Councilman Nichols offered the following resolution and moved its adoption: (RESOLUTION)
RESOLVED: That the resignation of Ivan Williams as Judge of the Corporation Court, this
day submitted to the Council, be accepted and that the Council does hereby express its
decision to be that Ivan Williams will not be the Judge of the Corporation Court of the
City of Austin after February 23, 1968.
-CITY OF AUSTIN. TEXAS
February 5, 1968
The motion, seconded by Councilman LaRue, carried by the following vote: Ayes:
Mayor Akin, Councilmen LaRue, Nichols
Noes: None
Absent: Councilmen Janes, Long
Councilman Nichols moved the Council adjourn. The motion, seconded by Councilman LaRue,
carried by the following vote: Ayes:
Noes:
Councilmen LaRue, Nichols, Mayor Akin
None
Absent: Councilmen Janes, Long
The Council adjourned at 4:40 Ρ.Μ.
